statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → (n:ℝ)/144 ≤ (major n).re

brief.en: The accepted catalogue statement hides its witness. Extract the explicit constant from the closing proof of #316 with the same threshold, arcs and frequency.
